name: public terrain posterior action gate
candidate_actions: Only frozen parent legal fields, complete assignments, and a 60 s science probe
actor_information: initialize, issued bulletins, own actions, public last_result hits, certified support constraints
forbidden_actor_information: weather/events truth, hidden pointing offset, future unpublished bulletins, hidden terrain bounds
objective: Group predicted worlds by public probe feedback; choose the maximum conditional expected terminal continuation within each group; include probe opportunity cost
stop_if: Neither fixed state admits a different legal continuation after posterior update
No reliable same-exposure positive anchor or less than 60 s left in public slot
Continuation value difference does not exceed science and deadline opportunity cost
Frozen prefix cannot reproduce the reference actions exactly
season_test: Only after a legal action difference and exact prefix gate; genuine same-prefix replanning to terminal state, equal source/budget, all terminal score components
deployment: No adoption until complete strong-control card tests show positive mean and preserve required/REQ performance
